segments.text: Uniform, binomial, Poisson, normal, Pareto, chi-square... so many distributions!
segments.caption: Uniform, binomial, Poisson, normal, Pareto, chi-square... so many distributions!

segments.text: Which one do you need? Here's the complete cheat sheet.
segments.caption: Which one do you need? Here's the complete cheat sheet.

segments.text: First, a quick reminder, in simple words.
segments.caption: First, a quick reminder, in simple words.

segments.text: A probability distribution shows how likely each possible value is.
segments.caption: A probability distribution shows how likely each possible value is.

segments.text: To pick the right one, just ask: what am I measuring?
segments.caption: To pick the right one, just ask: what am I measuring?

segments.text: They come in three families: counts, measurements, and tools for testing.
segments.caption: They come in three families: counts, measurements, and tools for testing.

segments.text: Counts first.
segments.caption: Counts first.

segments.text: One yes-or-no try? Bernoulli.
segments.caption: One yes-or-no try? Bernoulli.

segments.text: Successes in a fixed number of tries? Binomial.
segments.caption: Successes in a fixed number of tries? Binomial.

segments.text: Tries until the first success? Geometric.
segments.caption: Tries until the first success? Geometric.

segments.text: Events in a stretch of time? Poisson.
segments.caption: Events in a stretch of time? Poisson.

segments.text: Every outcome equally likely? Uniform.
segments.caption: Every outcome equally likely? Uniform.

segments.text: Now, measurements.
segments.caption: Now, measurements.

segments.text: Values clustered around an average? Normal.
segments.caption: Values clustered around an average? Normal.

segments.text: Waiting time until the next event? Exponential.
segments.caption: Waiting time until the next event? Exponential.

segments.text: Positive values, skewed by growth? Log-normal.
segments.caption: Positive values, skewed by growth? Log-normal.

segments.text: A few giants holding most of it? Pareto.
segments.caption: A few giants holding most of it? Pareto.

segments.text: And two tools for testing.
segments.caption: And two tools for testing.

segments.text: The average of a small sample? The t-distribution.
segments.caption: The average of a small sample? The t-distribution.

segments.text: Do counts match what you expect? Chi-square.
segments.caption: Do counts match what you expect? Chi-square.

segments.text: Bonus: see two humps? That's bimodal, usually two groups mixed together.
segments.caption: Bonus: see two humps? That's bimodal, usually two groups mixed together.

segments.text: So remember: ask what you're measuring, then match the shape.
segments.caption: So remember: ask what you're measuring, then match the shape.

segments.text: Save this cheat sheet, and you'll always know which one to use.
segments.caption: Save this cheat sheet, and you'll always know which one to use.

segments.text: Quick quiz!
segments.caption: Quick quiz!

segments.text: You measure how long each customer waits on hold.
segments.caption: You measure how long each customer waits on hold.

segments.text: Which distribution fits best?
segments.caption: Which distribution fits best?

segments.text: Exponential!
segments.caption: Exponential!

segments.text: It's a waiting time until the next event. Counting the calls would be Poisson.
segments.caption: It's a waiting time until the next event. Counting the calls would be Poisson.

segments.caption: Next: how sure can we be about an average? Confidence intervals.
